translation: This speaks of qi. As for the functions of flavor: sour can gather (收), sweet can relax (緩), acrid can disperse (散), bitter can harden (堅), and salty can soften (輕). Sour belongs to wood. Metal-dryness governs scattering and falling, and wood opposes it. Earth-dampness governs relaxing, and water overcomes it; therefore it can gather.
translator_notes: 五味 functions rendered with technical terms: 收 gather, 緩 relax, 散 disperse, 堅 harden, 輕 soften.
